caption:
You're sure your failure will break it. One more slip and you'll lose everything — but what if the whole thing was signed by Someone who cannot fail? (Galatians 3:15 devotional)

In Genesis 15 God alone passed between the split pieces as a smoking torch — swearing the death-oath by Himself, though you were the covenant-breaker. Once a covenant is ratified, no one annuls it or adds to it. So the bond stands on His faithfulness, not yours: if we are faithless, He remains faithful. He signed it alone, and He keeps it alone.
